rules: A finite search is not a novelty certificate.
An exact function match is not full-theory equivalence.
Unretrieved leads cannot support exact equation claims.
Numerical verification, originality and empirical adequacy are independent.
Historical research outputs and failed gates remain unchanged.

claims.claim: Completion I mu_PM matches FB2005 equation 5
claims.permitted_wording: Known Bekenstein-toy function, rationalized and implemented here; source regime qualifications retained.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: An original interpolation function or a proof of full TeVeS equivalence.
claims.next_step: Apply attribution to new manuscript equations; preserve frozen code and archives.

claims.claim: g = g_N + sqrt(a_star*g_N) in the algebraic spherical relation
claims.permitted_wording: The algebraic inverse of a known interpolation; coefficient empirically fitted here.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Independently discovering a new acceleration law or predicting a_star merely by re-expressing a fitted coefficient.
claims.next_step: Separate calibration, source mass construction and dynamical derivation.

claims.permitted_wording: An AQUAL-type field construction with specified constitutive function.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: This project invented div(mu grad Phi) = 4*pi*G*rho or its variational derivative relation.
claims.next_step: Add source labels; compare boundary and geometry assumptions.

claims.claim: Shared spherical law across different field completions
claims.permitted_wording: Coincident spherical behavior does not identify their nonspherical fields or light sectors.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Completion II is QUMOND, or RUT is TeVeS, solely because circular-force formulas agree.
claims.next_step: Compare complete PDEs, couplings and boundary conditions on the same nonspherical source.

claims.claim: Particle-written relaxing field with gradient feedback
claims.permitted_wording: Adaptation of an established memory-mediated particle-field architecture.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: First path-memory feedback system, or an exact equivalence obtained by silently removing drag/drive/diffusion.
claims.next_step: Build term-by-term maps and reproduce the closest published control.

claims.permitted_wording: An established distinction applied and quantitatively tested in our particular model.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: First discovery that a cold supported ring can fail without lag, or that memory changes collective modes.
claims.next_step: Identify which quantitative or general result remains after the active-lattice comparison.

claims.claim: Pressure or velocity spread can suppress attractive aggregation
claims.permitted_wording: A model-specific rotating memory-mediated stability calculation.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: First discovery that warm orbital populations can be more stable than cold ones.
claims.next_step: Validate and compare the response before claiming a new threshold.

claims.claim: Shared-field stabilization of collectively moving unstable constituents
claims.permitted_wording: A close experimental comparator with a different isolated instability and external drive; preprint status explicit.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: First stable moving collective from individually unstable units via a shared memory field, or already observed gravitational memory.
claims.next_step: Compare bounce/coalescence versus orbital instability and the role of repulsion, drive and source law.

claims.claim: Two first-order stages, second-order field equation and two-pole transfer function
claims.permitted_wording: Equivalent representations of the same linear response; the coupling-specific collective outcome remains to assess.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: A new memory principle solely from introducing two auxiliary time constants.
claims.next_step: Test matched static gain and correctly initialized full histories.

claims.claim: RUT reciprocal stationary energy reduces to attractive Gaussian pair energy
claims.permitted_wording: An exact stationary reduction under the declared mass-proportional symmetric-kernel assumptions.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: An exact dynamical equivalence of finite-history RUT and an instantaneous pair potential.
claims.next_step: Retain finite-history tests and source/force reciprocity.

claims.claim: The complete reciprocal two-stage gravitational interpretation
claims.permitted_wording: A particular proposed effective model using established system-field strategies; complete originality unverified.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: A new fundamental interaction or a physically identified heat bath proven by the energy ledger.
claims.next_step: Compare full actions/couplings and specify reservoir, momentum and causality.

claims.claim: Nonlocal gravity, modified inertia, self-force and wave memory
claims.permitted_wording: Prior gravitational-history ideas with explicitly different mechanisms.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: The concept of gravitational memory originated here, or all meanings of memory are equivalent.
claims.next_step: Keep variable, source, causal and observational maps separate.

claims.claim: Ring Bessel integrals, Jacobians, variational identities and standard stability tests
claims.permitted_wording: Established mathematics applied to a proposed source model.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: An original Bessel identity, phase-space measure or stability criterion.
claims.next_step: Use identity checks for correctness, not to certify priority.

claims.claim: Response matrices and contour-integral eigenvalue solvers
claims.permitted_wording: Published methods adapted and verified for the specified model.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: A new gravity result because an established eigensolver is implemented.
claims.next_step: Reproduce published benchmarks and keep search-region limits explicit.

claims.permitted_wording: A constitutive modeling direction with known transport and minimal-coupling structures.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Frame dragging already carves a growing rut, or an advected tensor is identical to our scalar relaxation.
claims.next_step: Declare carrier dynamics, frame and momentum/energy exchanges before testing.

claims.claim: A general support-torque trade-off or mode-selection rule for RUT
claims.permitted_wording: A possible contribution if a new scoped theorem or prediction survives comparison.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Novelty established by a finite search or by internal reproduction alone.
claims.next_step: Derive the scoped result, benchmark the closest prior models and test an independent prediction.

claims.claim: RUT as an observationally adequate theory of gravity
claims.permitted_wording: A gravitational hypothesis under investigation, separate from known empirical acceleration fits.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Prior-art overlap validates the model physically, or RUT inherits PM-1's data score.
claims.next_step: Preserve numerical limitations; derive universal source parameters and actual observational predictions.
